cases.title: confirmed access changes the feasibility verdict
cases.expectation: an observation below the 0.32 threshold fails the gate; a physical answer passes it

cases.title: destroying the result reproduces the pre-reader decision
cases.expectation: with no row the gate falls back to exactly the band's observation

cases.title: a negative suppresses this target only
cases.expectation: the refutation blocks this place; another place with good observation still passes

cases.title: a non-water answer changes nothing in the water reader
cases.expectation: only the water_access question may move the access verdict
cases.note: route_repeatability was REMOVED as a question (§8); route evidence is a by-product of any completed party.

cases.title: same-snapshot production counterfactual through the real tick
cases.expectation: one evidence row changes the band's own recorded destination verdict

cases.title: resource presence enables a later test candidate
cases.expectation: eligibility flips; NO support or food is created

cases.title: destroying the resource result removes eligibility
cases.expectation: the exact reader counterfactual, and a negative does not enable either

cases.title: a negative bounded search is not global absence
cases.expectation: the negative blocks this place and this question only; other places stay eligible

cases.title: an unwalked route remains unconfirmed
cases.expectation: route repeatability is no longer a question a party can 'pass' by definition
cases.note: §8 removal: any completed party is a successful round trip, so the question was a tautology.

cases.title: temporary-use result changes only bounded-use eligibility
cases.expectation: a failure blocks a task camp there; it moves no water and no resource state

cases.title: same-season attempts do not create seasonal persistence
cases.expectation: four spring visits give ONE season of coverage; a real new season gives two
cases.note: state does not grow with repeats — the row is upserted, which is the §11 bound.

cases.title: repeated identical confirmed verification is suppressed
cases.expectation: 500 ticks later, unchanged conditions, the same question is NOT re-asked

observed.sameConditionsReason: already established here, and nothing about the question has changed

cases.note: the 12-entry display ring is NOT consulted — this is the separate retry memory.

cases.title: a changed season permits a relevant retry
cases.expectation: an unanswered season or a materially different route reopens it; hardship does NOT

observed.newSeason: true (a season this place has not been answered in)
observed.movedRoute: true (the way there has materially changed)
observed.movedHardship: false (already established here, and nothing about the question has changed)

cases.note: hardship survives in RetryConditions only because the launch policy reads it as motivation.
